name: Appointment Reminders
outcome: Help patients prepare for visits and confirm, reschedule, or ask the practice for assistance.
required_inputs: Trusted appointment data or staff-approved schedule
Verified contact and applicable consent state
guardrails: A reminder must not expose unnecessary clinical details.
Never represent an appointment request as confirmed without trusted scheduling confirmation.
Do not retry indefinitely or message after opt-out.
Do not send from the local synthetic demo.
activation_requirements: Validated scheduling source and timezone behavior.
Provider delivery, idempotency and retry/dead-letter handling.
Clinic-reviewed wording, consent rules, opt-out and privacy review.
